summary: GOS-53 | Verify Users | functional-ui | A confirmed delete creates exactly one audit entry
title: A confirmed delete creates exactly one audit entry
preconditions: The tester is logged in to the console with a dedicated test account [VALID_ADMIN_USERNAME] [TO BE CONFIRMED: check on build]
The Verify Users list 'List Users' is open (route [TO BE CONFIRMED]) and holds the synthetic deletable pending user [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_NAME] [TO BE CONFIRMED: deletable test data]
The tester can read the audit log [TO BE CONFIRMED: how testers view the entry]

steps.action: Read the audit log and note the number of entries
steps.expected: The entry count E is noted [TO BE CONFIRMED: view method]

steps.action: Click the Delete button in the row of [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_NAME]
steps.expected: The native popup 'Do you want to delete this User Details?' opens with OK and Cancel

steps.action: Click OK in the popup
steps.expected: The user is deleted and the success alert is shown

steps.expected: Exactly E+1 entries exist; one new entry is for this deletion

summary: GOS-53 | Verify Users | negative | Cancel in the popup creates no audit entry
title: Cancel in the popup creates no audit entry
preconditions: The tester is logged in to the console with a dedicated test account [VALID_ADMIN_USERNAME] [TO BE CONFIRMED: check on build]

summary: GOS-53 | Verify Users | negative | A failed delete leaves no audit entry saying the user was deleted

The Verify Users list 'List Users' is open (route [TO BE CONFIRMED]) and holds the synthetic deletable pending user [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_NAME] [TO BE CONFIRMED: deletable test data]

steps.expected: The entry count E is noted [TO BE CONFIRMED: view method]

steps.expected: Network is offline

steps.action: Click Delete in the row of [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_NAME] and click OK

summary: GOS-53 | Verify Users | security | A delete request without a session creates no audit entry
title: A delete request without a session creates no audit entry
preconditions: The tester has no logged-in session (new browser context)
The delete link of the design (GET /admin/Users/Unverify_delete with id and page parameters) is known for [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_ID] [TO BE CONFIRMED: final request form]
The tester can read the audit log in a separate logged-in session [TO BE CONFIRMED: how testers view the entry]

steps.action: In the logged-in session, read the audit log and note the number of entries
steps.expected: The entry count E is noted [TO BE CONFIRMED: view method]

steps.action: In the session-less context, open the delete link for the user
steps.expected: The browser is redirected to /admin/login

steps.action: In the logged-in session, read the audit log again
steps.expected: Still E entries; nothing is recorded for [EXISTING_PENDING_USER_ID] and the user is still listed

tier: P1 - unauthenticated request must leave no trace (priority raised: security, BR-001)
automation_rationale: no until a way to read the audit log and a test environment exist
notes: Companion of TC-USRSRCH-23 (GOS-52), which checks the list; this checks the log. View method and request form [TO BE CONFIRMED]
